messages.subject: Link Box to MenuItem
parts:
I want to link a box an internal href to a menuItem

For Example:

ui <- dashboardPage(
  dashboardSidebar(
  sidebarMenu(
      menuItem("First", tabName = "first"),
      menuItem("Second", tabName = "second")
    )
)

messages.author: 7fde46832b1c255d
messages.subject: Re: Link Box to MenuItem
parts:
In Shinydashboard,

I want to create an internal HREF for a box that is in dashboardBody to a menuItem. Can this be done?


For Example, create a box in the first tab that links to the second tab, and a box in the second tab that links to the first tab.

ui <- dashboardPage(
  dashboardSidebar(
    sidebarMenu(
        menuItem("First", tabName = "first"),
        menuItem("Second", tabName = "second")
    )
  )

dashboardBody(
    tabItems(
      tabItem(tabName = "first",
              fluidRow(
                      infoBox(tags$a(href = "#shiny-tab-second"))
              )
      )
       tabItem(tabName = "second",
              fluidRow(
                      infoBox(tags$a(href = "#shiny-tab-first"))
              )
      )
    )
  )
)
